message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  In total, roughly **48,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~23,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

These figures come from contemporary reports and modern historical analyses.  The combined toll of about 48,000 men made Waterloo one of the most costly battles of the era.
